extracted.name: Mom's Party Potatoes
extracted.description: This recipe is for a quick and easy potato casserole using mozzarella cheese, sour cream, and prepared frozen cubed potatoes.
ingredient_lines: 1 (2 pound) package frozen cubed hash brown potatoes, thawed
1 (10.75 ounce) can cream of chicken soup
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Mix potatoes, mozzarella cheese, sour cream, cream of chicken soup, butter, onion, salt, and black pepper together in a casserole dish.
Bake in preheated oven until hot throughout and bubbly on top, about 30 minutes.
